text:
maya: Quick heads-up — during the AWQ vs FP8 bakeoff yesterday we saw a consistent accuracy gap on the 'billing-clarify' prompt bucket (~3.8% sacrebleu drop) when routing to AWQ-int8 variants.
liam: Can you paste the eval snippet and sample cases? :eyes:
maya: Sure — snippet below:
```
model: awq-7b-int8
bucket: billing-clarify
n=500
metric: sacrebleu
delta: -3.8
examples: ["Why was my invoice higher this month?", "Charge still pending—what happened?"]
```
olivia: Interesting. Is the same gap present on private/dedicated runs or only hosted microbatches?
maya: Only hosted so far, on A100 microbatch=4. Dedicated runs (v0.3 quant profile) show ~1.1% delta.
devon: That suggests a runtime/compilation difference — potentially kernel selection for small batches. Can we repro locally with microbatch=4 and kernel logs on a dedicated node?
maya: Trying now. Also capturing KV cache hit rates — might be prefix sensitivity.
qa-bot: Regression alert created: RG-2026-042 — linked eval artifact s3://redwood-evals/rg-2026-042
liam: If this is prompt-bucket specific we should add a quick mitigation: coverage-tag routing. Route 'billing-clarify' to fp8/gptq for hosted until we fix AWQ.
olivia: Agree. Proposed handoff: 0-1% traffic to AWQ for that bucket, 99% to fp8, ramp after stability. Canary window 24h, metric SLO: sacrebleu >= baseline-1.0.
maya: I can push a traffic rule in the console. Quick draft:
```
match: prompt.bucket == "billing-clarify"
route:
  primary: fp8-7b (99%)
  fallback: awq-7b-int8 (1%)
canary: 24h
quality_gate: sacrebleu.delta <= 1.0
```
devon: Also add a runtime flag to force host->dedicated fallback if latency p95 > 350ms for that bucket — avoids customer impact.
liam: Good call. Also log sample ids to eval store for postmortem; include a small random sample of 50 requests for human review.
maya: Done — pushing rule now. tagging @oncall in case the canary needs roll-back.
deploy-bot: rule-deploy started by maya at 2331234575
deploy-bot: rule-deploy succeeded at 2331234610
olivia: Monitoring dashboards now show sacrebleu moving back toward baseline. :thumbsup:
maya: Filing a follow-up ticket to reproduce kernel mismatch and coordinate with eng-runtime. TAG: runtime-quant-investigation
liam: Thanks — great fast mitigation. Keep notes in the eval artifact and close RG-2026-042 when we validate.
